feats.title: Blood Thirst
feats.description: You have combat advantage against bloodied enemies.

feats.title: Devastating Critical
feats.description: Whenever you score a critical hit, the target takes ongoing damage equal to your level and a -2 penalty to the defense targeted by the attack (save ends both). The ongoing damage is of the same types dealt by the critical hit, if any.

feats.title: Empty Vessel
feats.description: The first time you drop to 0 power points during an encounter, you gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and a +2 bonus to all defenses until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Eyes in the Back of Your Head
feats.description: Being flanked doesn't cause you to grant combat advantage. You gain a +2 feat bonus to Perception checks, increasing to +3 at 21st level.

feats.title: Gritty Determination
feats.description: Whenever you use a Daily power as a standard action, you gain temporary hit points equal to your healing surge value.

feats.title: Luck of the Gods
feats.description: When you roll a natural 20 on an attack roll, skill check, or saving throw, remove all effects on you that a save can end.

feats.title: Quick Recovery
feats.description: You gain one additional healing surge. Whenever you achieve a milestone, you regain a healing surge.

feats.title: Repel Charge
feats.description: Whenever an enemy makes a charge attack against you, you can make a melee basic attack against that enemy as an opportunity action.

feats.title: Unexpected Escape
feats.description: You gain a +4 bonus to Strength or Dexterity checks made to escape a grab and any other effect that allows you to escape. Whenever you successfully escape, you can shift 2 squares.

feats.title: Unfailing Courage
feats.description: When you spend an action point, you can also spend a healing surge.

feats.title: War Wizardry
feats.description: Your arcane spells take a –5 penalty on attack rolls against allies, and deal only half their normal damage to allies.
